extensionName: Universal Logic, Controls & Code Injection Core

newBlocks.tooltip: The absolute execution entry point. Program initialization lines trigger sequentially out of this node's exit port.
An infinite repeating execution frame loop. Continuously drives downstream physics, graphics, and keys scanner pipelines.
Injects a raw text snippet directly into the compilation pipeline stream, formatted to match the selected target language.
Carves out a fixed contiguous item memory storage block in safe user RAM to track weapons or inventory data.
Executes an assembly bit operation to toggle item properties like equipped, consumable, or collected variables fields.
Carves out an 8-slot selection pointer index layout in safe calculator RAM to track active player inventory slots.
Down-samples your background map data layout array into a compressed pixel grid overlay written to top VRAM coordinates.
Evaluates two data variables or positions against a mathematical operator condition to trigger logical switches.
newBlocks.ez80AssemblyTemplate:
ld hl, ({RegisterAlpha})
ld de, {ValueBeta}
or a
sbc hl, de
jr z, _CompareConditionFailed
jr nc, _CompareConditionFailed

newBlocks.tooltip: Performs low-level mathematical operations directly across system variables matrices.
newBlocks.ez80AssemblyTemplate:
ld hl, ({TargetVariable})
ld de, {ValueDelta}
add hl, de
ld ({TargetVariable}), hl

newBlocks.tooltip: Evaluates the contents of a memory address; forces hard limits to prevent data variables overflow.
newBlocks.ez80AssemblyTemplate:
ld hl, ({MemoryPointer})
ld de, {AbsoluteFloor}
or a
sbc hl, de
jr nc, _CheckCeiling
ld hl, {AbsoluteFloor}
_CheckCeiling:
ld de, {AbsoluteCeiling}
or a
sbc hl, de
jr c, _ClampDone
ld hl, {AbsoluteCeiling}
_ClampDone:
ld ({MemoryPointer}), hl
